The '''LNR Series I Systemary Laser Battery''' was a planetary [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] model used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the predecessor of the [[LNR Series II Systemary Laser Battery|LNR series II]].

==Description==
The LNR Series I consisted of a single-[[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] cannon situated on a tower.
